title: Ghastlings – Companion Souls
description: Ghastlings adds adorable Ghast Soul companions that orbit around you in battle. Capture them, power them up with elemental essences, and watch them fight alongside you with unique abilities!
body:
# **✨ Ghastlings**

> **"A companion mod that lets you capture, customize, and command your own elemental Ghast Soul friends."**

Ghastlings introduces a brand-new companion system to Minecraft. Capture ethereal Ghast Souls, infuse them with powerful elemental essences, and watch as they loyally orbit around you—ready to defend you with their unique abilities!

![Ghastlings Showcase](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1414685/description_bb1acf4e-3a5f-4c34-8fe7-8530fce0a99e.png)

---

## 🎯 **What does this mod do?**

Ever wanted a ghostly companion that fights by your side? One that floats behind you, reacts to enemies, and grows stronger over time? **Ghastlings** makes it happen.

**Capture. Infuse. Command.**

---

## ✨ **Key Features**

| Icon | Feature Description                                                                           |
| :--: | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
|  👻  | **Loyal Companions:** Adorable Ghast Soul companions that follow you everywhere         |
| ⚔️ | **9 Elemental Affinities:** Unique combat abilities and elemental attack styles         |
|  📈  | **Level-Up System:** Train your souls from Level 1 to 5 for increased damage and health |
|  💔  | **Dynamic Durability:** Your companion takes damage in combat and requires care         |
|  ✨  | **Passive Regeneration:** Souls automatically heal when resting in your inventory       |
|  🔧  | **Soul Smithing Table:** Custom workstation for crafting, infusing, and upgrading       |
|  🎒  | **Dedicated Slot:** Special inventory companion slot that keeps your hands free         |

---

## 👻 **Meet the Ghastlings**

Collect all 9 elemental variants, each with their own unique visual style and combat power.

![Ghastling Variants](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1414685/description_4e46a6d6-3bf6-43bc-bcdf-d40d097a33d1.gif)

---

## 🔍 **Mechanics & Details**

### ⚒️ Soul Smithing Table

The dedicated workstation for all Ghast Soul operations. Craft souls, infuse elements, and level up your companions with an intuitive interface.

![Soul Smithing Table](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1414685/description_c70adddb-3055-4726-a81d-df8d189af8cd.gif)

---

### 🔥 Elemental Affinities

Each Ghast Soul can be infused with a unique elemental essence discovered across the world:

| Element               | Combat Ability                          | Essence Location                  |
| :-------------------- | :-------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------- |
| 🔥**Fire**      | Shoots explosive fireballs              | Bastions, Nether Fortresses       |
| ⚡**Lightning** | Summons devastating lightning strikes   | Trial Chambers, Buried Treasure   |
| 💚**Healing**   | Heals you when your health drops low    | Witch Huts, Village Temples       |
| 💨**Wind**      | Launches high-impact wind charges       | Trial Chambers                    |
| 🧊**Ice**       | Freezes enemies and inflicts slowness   | Igloos, Snow Villages             |
| ☠️**Poison**  | Inflicts deadly poison damage over time | Jungle Temples, Pillager Outposts |
| 💧**Water**     | Grants water breathing and swim speed   | Ocean Ruins, Shipwrecks           |
| 💀**Wither**    | Applies corrosive wither effects        | Wither Skeletons                  |
| 🟣**Ender**     | Fires homing shulker bullets            | End Cities                        |

![Elemental Attacks](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1414685/description_0fb638dc-7f5c-43e1-a0a0-508d88a6fe6f.gif)

---

### 📈 Level System

Your Ghast Soul grows significantly stronger with each level upgrade:

|            Level            | Companion HP | Damage Multiplier |
| :-------------------------: | :----------: | :---------------: |
|     ⭐**Level 1**     |  `20 HP`  |     `1.0x`     |
|    ⭐⭐**Level 2**    |  `25 HP`  |     `1.1x`     |
|   ⭐⭐⭐**Level 3**   |  `30 HP`  |     `1.2x`     |
|  ⭐⭐⭐⭐**Level 4**  |  `35 HP`  |     `1.3x`     |
| ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**Level 5** |  `40 HP`  |     `1.5x`     |

> 💡 **Tip:** Upgrade your souls using **Soul Essence** in the **Soul Smithing Table**!

![Level Up Animation](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1414685/description_1776eda6-1263-461d-9a20-92754e9163e7.gif)

---

### 💔 Durability System

Your Ghast Soul isn't invincible! When equipped, your companion can take damage from enemy attacks:

- **Visual Health Bar:** A dedicated durability bar displays your companion's remaining health.
- **Dynamic Indicators:** Color transitions smoothly from 🟢 Green to 🟡 Yellow to 🔴 Red as health drops.
- **Passive Recovery:** Unequipped souls resting in your inventory heal **1 HP every 30 seconds**.
- **Smithing Requirement:** The Soul Smithing Table requires the soul to be at **100% health** before upgrading.
- ⚠️ **Critical Warning:** If your companion's health reaches 0, the soul dies and the item is destroyed permanently!

---

### 👹 Soul Keepers & Soul Shards

In the depths of the **Soul Sand Valley**, mysterious **Soul Keepers** roam the foggy wasteland. Defeat these formidable spirits to obtain **Soul Shards**—a rare material essential for crafting and upgrading Ghast Souls!

![Soul Keeper](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1414685/description_5cdcfa6d-104a-4b7d-9779-c94290e096a0.png)

---

## 🎮 **Compatibility**

| Spec                        | Detail                 |
| :-------------------------- | :--------------------- |
| **Minecraft Version** | `1.21.11`            |
| **Mod Loader**        | `Fabric`             |
| **Dependencies**      | Requires`Fabric API` |

---

## 📥 **Installation**

1. Download and install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/).
2. Download and install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
3. Download the latest release of **Ghastlings**.
4. Place the downloaded `.jar` file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
5. Launch the game and enjoy!

---

## ❓ **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How do I get my first Ghast Soul?**

> **A:** Craft a Soul Vessel, then combine it with a Dried Ghast inside the Soul Smithing Table.

**Q: Where do I find Dried Ghast?**

> **A:** Dried Ghast is dropped by regular Ghasts when defeated in the Nether.

**Q: How do I get Soul Crystal?**

> **A:** Smelt Soul Sand in a regular furnace or blast furnace to obtain Soul Crystals.

**Q: How do I level up my Ghast Soul?**

> **A:** Craft Soul Essence using Soul Shards and Soul Crystals, then combine it with your companion in the Soul Smithing Table.

**Q: Can my Ghast Soul die permanently?**

> **A:** Yes! If its health reaches 0 in combat, the item is destroyed. Unequip it to let it heal!

**Q: Does it work on multiplayer servers?**

> **A:** Yes! It is a server-compatible mod that synchronizes all companion animations and stats with clients.

**Q: Is it compatible with other mods?**

> **A:** Yes, it works seamlessly with most mods as it utilizes standalone, custom container systems.
